summary: Axillary thin skin: compare broad-lumened apocrine secretion into the upper hair follicle with eccrine secretion and salt-modifying duct outflow to a separate surface pore. Read double-layer duct epithelium separately from coil basal lamina.
scale_note: Block approximately 3 mm wide. Nominal 1.5 mm per authored unit. Epidermis, cells, gland winding and fine structures are schematic. Four melanocytes and dendrites are enlarged 2x; vessel/nerve calibres and density are representative. Flow colors are schematic, not oxygen or sweat concentration. Cell inset uses separate schematic space with no physical ruler.

description_overrides.Apocrine sweat gland: Apocrine secretory tubule wall: larger tubules and broader lumina than the eccrine units in this axillary thin-skin block. Simple secretory epithelium with basal myoepithelial support belongs inside its basal lamina. Apical snout relief is a recognition cue, not separately selectable cells or proof of obligatory decapitation; authoritative histology teaches merocrine secretion. Protein/lipid-rich outflow enters the upper follicle and is initially odorless; bacterial surface processing generates characteristic odor. Isolated human glands respond to cholinergic and adrenergic agonists; this model does not claim exclusive intact-human transmitter control. See the separate schematic cell inset for cellular organization.
description_overrides.Eccrine sweat gland (secretory coil): Eccrine secretory tubule wall: deep dermal/upper hypodermal coil with lumen-facing clear and dark secretory cells and basal myoepithelial support. Predominantly sympathetic cholinergic activation supplies primary sweat to its lumen; basal support is not a peristaltic pump. The tissue-scale selector represents the wall, not individually modeled cells. The separate cell inset distinguishes secretory cells, myoepithelium and basal lamina without calibrating cell density.
description_overrides.Apocrine duct: Apocrine duct luminal epithelial coat: inner member of the two cuboidal epithelial layers. The narrower lumen carries secretion from the broad coil into the upper hair-follicle canal, superficial to sebaceous entry, through a local sheath aperture. It does not terminate at an independent surface pore. Select the basal epithelial coat separately. Shared interfaces are intentional; lumen is empty space.
description_overrides.Apocrine duct basal layer: Apocrine duct basal epithelial coat: outer cuboidal cell layer adjacent to the named luminal coat along the shared route. These basal duct cells are neither secretory myoepithelium nor basement membrane. Dimensions are schematic. The separate duct-cell inset shows individually selectable representatives.
description_overrides.Eccrine sweat duct: Eccrine duct luminal epithelial coat: inner member of the two cuboidal layers, joining the secretory coil, dermal duct and epidermal acrosyringium to an independent sweat pore. Duct transport reabsorbs NaCl from primary fluid; final composition depends on physiology and flow. Evaporation at the skin surface removes heat. Existing tissue-scale parts do not resolve transporter molecules or measured concentrations.
description_overrides.Eccrine duct basal layer: Eccrine duct basal epithelial coat: outer cuboidal layer sharing the inner-coat centerline and wall interface. It is distinct from the coil myoepithelial support and the noncellular basal lamina. Representative individual cells are shown only in the separate schematic duct fragment.
description_overrides.Apocrine basement membrane: Apocrine secretory-coil basal lamina: a separate noncellular shape-following shell around secretory tubules only; this selector does not cover the entire duct. Existing thickness is schematic 1.5 micrometres at the nominal block scale, not a specimen measurement. Preserve the contact with the external gland wall.
description_overrides.Eccrine basement membrane: Eccrine secretory-coil basal lamina: separate noncellular shape-following shell around secretory tubules only; not the full-duct membrane or basal epithelial layer. Existing thickness is schematic 1.05 micrometres at nominal block scale, not calibrated morphometry.
description_overrides.Adipocytes (fat lobules): Hypodermal adipose lobules at tissue scale: each yellow source volume represents a lobule containing many unilocular adipocytes, not one giant cell. Fibrous septa organize the lobules and carry larger vessels/nerves. Individual adipocyte nuclei and lipid droplets are not resolved in these retained meshes.
description_overrides.Cutaneous nerve & branches: Representative connected cutaneous nerve courses and local sensory branches, plus unresolved autonomic supply. Eccrine thermoregulatory control is predominantly cholinergic; apocrine autonomic responsiveness requires separate interpretation. Displayed yellow branches do not map transmitter-specific axons or neuronal cell bodies. Sensory cell bodies lie outside this skin block; density/calibre are schematic.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Polarized secretory epithelium supplies a wide lumen and follicular outflow

steps.caption: Locate the secretory epithelial wall, lumen and stromal boundary.
Trace apical secretion into the lumen; snouts alone do not establish obligatory cap loss.
The narrower duct has selected inner and outer epithelial coats.
Trace drainage through the sheath opening into the canal around the hair.
Surface bacterial processing generates characteristic odor.

No calibrated pulse rate or flow rate

No rendered bacteria currently exist

functional_sequences.mechanism: Fluid formation and duct modification precede surface heat loss

steps.caption: Predominantly cholinergic autonomic input activates eccrine secretion; upstream control is outside this block.
Secretory epithelial transport supplies primary fluid to the coil lumen; distinguish clear and dark cell detail from the basal support network.
As fluid passes through the duct, NaCl moves outward from its lumen.
The epidermal passage carries modified fluid to its own surface pore.
Evaporation removes heat; secretion alone is not the cooling step.

No inference of concentration from color
Final composition depends on flow and physiology

functional_sequences.mechanism: Peripheral epithelial renewal feeds lipid accumulation and whole-cell release

steps.caption: Conceptual holocrine stage (individual sebocytes not resolved in retained mesh): Identify a representative acinus and its peripheral proliferating cells.
Conceptual holocrine stage (individual sebocytes not resolved in retained mesh): Track a representative sebocyte toward the acinar center while its lipid content increases.
Conceptual holocrine stage (individual sebocytes not resolved in retained mesh): Central cells break down, contributing their lipid and cell contents to sebum.
Conceptual holocrine stage (individual sebocytes not resolved in retained mesh): Follow the short duct into the follicular canal, then toward skin and hair.

schematic_limitations: Individual cells require a new explicit detail view
Current gland part contains both lobules and duct
Progression is compressed and not a measured turnover clock
Arrector pili movement is not required to demonstrate holocrine secretion

functional_sequences.mechanism: Differentiating keratinocytes form mechanically connected strata and a cornified lipid barrier

steps.caption: Conceptual differentiation stage (individual keratinocytes not reconstructed here): Follow one representative basal keratinocyte while retaining its basement-side tissue context.
Conceptual differentiation stage (individual keratinocytes not reconstructed here): Compare attached polyhedral cells with the basal row; desmosomal contacts transmit mechanical cohesion.
Conceptual differentiation stage (individual keratinocytes not reconstructed here): Separate intracellular keratohyalin and cornified-envelope formation from extracellular lipid release.
Conceptual differentiation stage (individual keratinocytes not reconstructed here): Flattened corneocytes and surrounding lipids form the surface barrier.
Conceptual differentiation stage (individual keratinocytes not reconstructed here): Superficial attachment loss allows squames to shed while deeper tissue renews.

schematic_limitations: Renewal arrows depict cell lineage and differentiation, not a free cell stream
Do not reuse a sweat-flow direction legend
No distinct stratum lucidum is introduced into axillary thin skin
No calibrated four-week clock
Cell and organelle detail requires enlarged contextual inset

functional_sequences.mechanism: A dendritic pigment-producing cell supplies neighboring keratinocytes
